crossRefs.note: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.
They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.”

translations.web: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
translations.bsb: and His disciples asked Him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
translations.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
translations.asv: And his disciples asked him, saying, Rabbi, who sinned, this man, or his parents, that he should be born blind?
